CrossDesk Code Signing Policy

Last updated: August 8, 2026

Official CrossDesk Windows releases are digitally signed to help users confirm the publisher and verify that files have not been modified after signing.

Signing service and certificate

Free code signing is provided by SignPath.io, with a certificate provided by SignPath Foundation.
